scope: Broaden current peer research across ACadRust malformed-input reports, DXF angle-unit behavior, and the exact codec/application route declared by OpenCADStudio main.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research and local plan/source-coverage cross-check
sourceObservations: The reviewed OpenCADStudio mutable main declares an acadrust-named codec from the separate HakanSeven12/opencadcodec Git repository and separate kernel/graph Git dependencies; Cargo.toml contains abbreviated revisions, so any later run must record the full lock-resolved commits and built artifact.

ACadRust issue #123 reports count clamping combined with zero-padding and a separate stream-derived unbounded allocation. The issue describes peer-generated in-memory inputs; its cap and attempted allocation are not DWG format limits and were not independently reproduced here.
ACadRust issue #124 reports a one-bit mutation of a peer-generated AC1024 file that reaches an unchecked header slice and panics; this is a test-design lead, not evidence of a matching local failure.

ACadRust issue #134 reports 70 of 351 AC1032 inputs rejected by v0.6.4 where v0.6.3 reportedly opened them, mainly at MLeader context records. Customer inputs are unavailable and cause was not independently reproduced.

ACadRust issue #125 reports a TEXT group-51 degree/radian writer mismatch for a named historical source. The maintainer replied that it should be fixed upstream; no exact fixing commit or released-artifact verification was established, so this is historical regression evidence only.

Autodesk's DXF group-code documentation says filer-boundary angles in groups 50-59 are converted to/from degrees; application-side API values may be radians. The TEXT table identifies group 51 as oblique angle.
OpenCADStudio's README describes STEP AP203 export as mesh data and describes save_verified as application self-reopen/manifest validation; neither is exact-B-rep proof or an independent codec vote.
method.limitations: Mutable repository pages and issue reports are discovery evidence, not independently reproduced conformance results. No peer artifact was executed, no external/customer drawing was obtained, and no local DWG/DXF input was run in this research pass.

assessment.openCadStudioRoute: ACADRUST_FAMILY_APPLICATION_CONSUMER_WITH_DISTINCT_OPENCADCODEC_FORK; capture the full lock-resolved codec/kernel/graph commits and application build at any composed observation; not an independent parser vote.
assessment.malformedDwgReports: Map issues #123/#124 to existing count, byte-span, overflow, bounded-allocation, and fatal-header owners. Require no fabricated zero-padded semantic content and no unchecked slice/overflow. Do not copy peer thresholds.
assessment.ac1032MleaderContext: Issue #134 is an unavailable-customer-input report about strict bounded decode behavior. Retain explicit typed/opaque-bounded/skipped-incomplete/file-fatal outcomes; neither removing bounds nor broad catch-and-continue is justified.
assessment.angleUnitReport: Issue #125 is a historical test pattern with a maintainer-reported upstream fix. Use it only as a field- and direction-specific generated wire/model unit control when that route is in scope.
assessment.3dEvidenceCeiling: OpenCADStudio rendering or mesh-to-STEP output does not prove complete ACIS/AcDs association, exact B-rep semantics, independent-kernel agreement, or stock FreeCAD acceptance.
